d: Company Description Indian School Salalah is a NABET-accredited institution known for its strong infrastructure and state-of-the-art facilities, including specialized laboratories for science and computer studies, a fully computerized library, and smart board-enabled classrooms. The campus features a multipurpose hall, audio-visual room, and an imposing stage overlooking a lush green playground, supporting both academic and co-curricular activities. The school offers classes from LKG to XII with multiple sections, serving over 3,900 students and supported by a diverse team of teaching, non-teaching, and Omani staff members. Guided by an active School Management Committee and leadership team, Indian School Salalah is committed to delivering holistic education and continuously improving the learning environment.

Role Description The Teaching Professional will deliver high-quality classroom instruction, ensure effective lesson planning, and support the academic and holistic development of students across assigned grades and subjects. Responsibilities include preparing and implementing lesson plans aligned with school curriculum, assessing student performance, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining accurate records. The role involves designing engaging learning activities, integrating technology and audio-visual tools, managing classroom behavior, and collaborating with colleagues to enhance teaching practices. The Teaching Professional will also participate in school events, parent meetings, and professional development programs. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Salalah.
q: Candidates should possess strong Teaching and Education skills, with experience in classroom instruction and student-centered learning.
Candidates should possess solid Lesson Planning and Training skills to design, organize, and deliver structured learning sessions.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to engage students, collaborate with colleagues, and interact professionally with parents and guardians.
Relevant academic qualifications such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Education or in the subject area being taught.
Familiarity with CBSE or similar school curricula, and experience working in a multicultural school environment is beneficial.
Ability to integrate educational technology and smart classroom tools into teaching practices.
Strong organizational skills, classroom management abilities, and a commitment to continuous professional growth.
